exec: Servers of the Kursk governor's live phone-in were reportedly targeted by a cyberattack attempt, with transmission interruptions during the broadcast.
geo_basis: Kursk region, as stated in the source
org: Kursk Oblast governor's live phone-in (Alexander Khinshtein)
plain: Life.ru reports an attempted cyberattack on the servers of the Kursk governor's live phone-in. The broadcast had communication problems and interruptions, and was restored.
summary: Life.ru reports, citing the newspaper Kurskaya Pravda, that the servers of Kursk Governor Alexander Khinshtein's live phone-in line were subjected to a cyberattack attempt. Communication problems and transmission interruptions occurred during the broadcast, which was restored by the time of publication. Life.ru says a similar incident disabled the telephone system in December 2024. The official source was not read.
title: Kursk governor's live phone-in servers reportedly hit by cyberattack attempt, Life.ru says

validation.note: Single publisher (Life.ru) relaying Kurskaya Pravda; no official statement read.
